name: s81lk_kp4_dec
structural_change: S81-KP4 10-17 STREAMING REWRITE (replaces the 8cd04168b kit whose gate FAILED: 57,626 flops one root, CTS OOM, bsel/sc/AND4 fanouts 11-23.6k, 46-level Chien/Forney cycle): syndromes on the arriving stream (fixed-offset one-hot chunk select, window matrix registered a cycle ahead, loop <= 9 inputs); 3 RiBM key-equation units (one GF multiply + XOR a cycle, control copies per PE group); forward Chien/Forney in two registered stages; the received codeword waits in a 64x546 SRAM delay line (u_dmem) and the correction masks in a 32x546 SRAM delay (u_cmem) -- no codeword flop copies (6 x 5,440 before). Regional synchronous reset tree, no datapath reset, every wide select replicated (<= ~140 loads a copy). RTL latency p_d -> q_d 59 cycles (was ~81: -22 for the link latency model) + 2 pin registers (recipe 4). Outline 367.2 x 345.6 (aspect 1.06): both SRAMs (pins on their W / E edges only) on the 43.2 lattice in the upper middle, std cells in one band around them; p_d over the full W face (PMA side), q_* over the full E face (rate matcher side), clk / rst_n S centre. Exact vs rs544.py (KP4 bench base PASS: 140 out, 122 exact, 17 flagged, 0 miscorrected; DMUT2 FAIL).

job.purpose: S81 link KP4 decoder leaf (one per SerDes link macro), streaming rewrite 10-17. Bench = KP4 base (140 frames out, 122 exact, 17 beyond-t flagged, 0 miscorrected vs rs544.py) and decoder mutant DMUT2 (Forney).
